milestone.name: K7.7.2 - Re-entry Reconstruction Algorithm
milestone.summary: Freeze algorithm that reinterprets stored re-entry state with current time gap, user intent, and project reality.

review.name: K7.7.2 Re-entry Reconstruction Algorithm Contract Freeze

principle: Re-entry Reconstruction = Re-entry State + Current Reality + Current User Intent → Current Re-entry Interpretation.
acceptance_targets: Algorithm accepts stored Re-entry State, current user input, current time gap, and current project reality as separate inputs.
Algorithm outputs Current Re-entry Interpretation, not a recovered summary.
Interpretation includes whether to continue previous thought, lightly acknowledge it, archive it, or ask where to resume.
Interpretation uses freshness / momentum half-life to reduce stale re-entry influence.
Interpretation includes Cognitive Momentum and Relational Momentum influence levels.
If project reality has advanced, algorithm must not resume an obsolete unfinished thread as current.
If time gap is short, algorithm can preserve active continuation posture.
If time gap is long, algorithm must reduce emotional/session-specific intensity and require revalidation.
Algorithm does not generate final Julia response text.
Algorithm does not mutate identity, relationship, memory, or experience artifacts.
